input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text must also be co-signed by the key at /team/pieces/knight_g8.id and by the key of the agent whose path was planned for that ply, and must set /turn/ply.num to the current ply, so that knight_b8 cannot slip in an off-plan move without the planned mover's agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_g8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_b8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
